performance_issues.description: RewriteAllPublicKeys reads ALL public keys from DB and rewrites the entire authorized_keys file on every single key deletion
performance_issues.impact: For instances with many SSH keys, this is O(total_keys) filesystem I/O on every delete. Also holds SSHOpLocker mutex blocking all other SSH key operations
performance_issues.recommendation: Use incremental authorized_keys updates (remove single line) instead of full rewrite

optimization_recommendations.description: Defer authorized_keys rewrite or use incremental update
